nom: Beauty of Joseon Glow Deep Serum Rice Alpha-Arbutin Niacinamide for Uneven Dull Skin Tone

segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are mixed: one reports no irritation or buildup at all, while another initially saw good results — brightening with no redness or itching — before irritation eventually developed and she discontinued use, calling sensitive skin "difficult."
segments.oily: A reviewer with oily-leaning, mildly rosacea-prone skin reports no burning or reaction over two weeks of twice-daily use, along with improved pores, texture, and fading of dark marks.
segments.combination: A reviewer with combination skin and heavily clogged pores reports visible improvement, including blackheads vanishing, as part of a full routine.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report the serum keeps their skin feeling moisturized, though one wishes the formula were more moisturizing for her dry skin.

concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report the serum hydrates well and leaves skin soft without heaviness, including reviewers with dry skin; one reviewer with dry skin, however, says she wishes the formula were more moisturizing.
concerns.redness: Reviewers report the serum helps tone down redness, and one with mildly rosacea-prone skin reports no burning or reaction; one reviewer initially saw no redness or itching but developed irritation after continued use.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers are divided: several, including one with very sensitive skin, report no irritation or buildup and describe added barrier moisture, while others report the serum broke them out badly or eventually caused irritation after initially working well.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers report fading of dark marks, hyperpigmentation, or post-acne discoloration within a few weeks to a couple of months of consistent use, generally alongside brighter, more even-toned skin.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers report mixed results: some see clogged pores and blackheads clear up and post-pimple discoloration fade, while one reports the serum broke her out badly with large, painful pimples on skin that had previously been clear.

aspects.libelle: Frequent reports of formula, color, or bottle inconsistency across purchases
Small bottle relative to price and expectations
Can feel sticky or tacky if over-applied

extraits.texte: I gave into the tiktok hype thinking this serum would give me the glass skin I’ve been trying to achieve. I recently started using the cosrx snail mucin and it made my skin pretty clear, so I thought adding this to my routine would be the cherry on top. I WAS WRONG! This serum broke me out with HUGE pimples that literally hurt. My once clear skin that I finally had returned to its once irritated and textured state! I kept trying to incorporate it into my skin routine but it just keeps breaking me out again and again. Sucks that it doesn’t work for me. Will not be purchasing again.

Wow, I thought I'd get unlucky and that this serum would end up irritating me, but it's actually fine on me! The glow part is real... usually I'm so dull, but this brightens me right up! The difference is pretty freaking noticeable... Stopped using it for a day to see if it was the product making me red and itchy (it was not) and I kinda got jumpscared by the lack of shininess in the mirror. Super lightweight and not sticky! Edit: Ahh, the irritation came. Nothing crazy, but still irritation. I don't know if it's the product's incompatibility with my skin or with the other products in my routine, but I have bid farewell to this... Having sensitive skin sure is difficult...
Very light but hydrating. I am able to use it daily and put it under my eyes with no issues. I have very sensitive skin and this stuff causes no irritation or build up. Love it.

Mis resultados son: 1. Mejora la apariencia de los poros y la textura de la piel. 2. Aclara manchas y unifica el color del rostro. 3. Hace lucir la piel más iluminada e hidratada. Antes de opinar me gusta probarlo y así dar una opinión honesta. Mi piel tiene tendencia grasa con un poco se rosacea. Estuve usándolo por 15 días en la mañana y noche. No arde y no me dio ninguna reacción. Suspendí los demás serum de mi rutina para evaluar bien que tanto funcionaba. Solo mantuve mi crema hidratante y protector solar. Gorra y lentes cuando me expongo al sol, tomar suficiente agua y evitar tocar la cara con los dedos en el día a día. Seguiré usándolo y cuando se me acabe lo seguiré comprando. Pruebalo!

extraits.titre: Far exceeds the price point. In love with these products.
extraits.texte: The value is excellent for the cost. After purchasing nearly every Beauty of Joseon product, I followed a full glass skincare routine that ChatGPT created; just four days later, clients at the salon are asking about a change. The outcome already surpasses my Natura Bisse routine, which cost nearly ten times as much. I acquired all these items for less than the Natura $450 night cream. As a 45-year-old male with combination skin and heavily clogged pores, I am seeing blackheads vanish.
The product is good for my dry skin I wish it was more moisturizing

Originally liked this a lot. Purchase 7 times. After about the third time I noticed a difference in the bottle and the serum. I dont believe this is authentic. Originally it was a clear bottle, with a clear tinted yellowish serum. Recently, the bottle has been white and the serum very white and clouded. Idk what changed, but can no longer recommend from this seller. Original Review: After struggling with dark marks and an uneven complexion (most as a result of scars left behind by acne), I feel this has really help. I have noticed improvements in the darks and so far it does a phenomenal job. I have also noticed clearer, brighter skin - I feel moisturized and dewy. I will definitely purchase again and would recommend, as I think it’s worth the money. It doesn’t feel heavy, I don’t notice a scent. At first, I thought it was a bit sticky, by a little goes a long way. It only has that sticky feeling if I apply too much. Just a few drops is good. I use this in the morning, after washing my face. I am mostly indoors. However, don’t forget your sunscreen if you’re hoping to lessen dark marks.
